Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

Teach
• Focus skill: use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?
2. Which are some of the words you use to talk about how someone feels or looks?
3. How do we describe things?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
